title: TACT: A Pragmatic Approach to Qualitative Analysis with an AI Council
abstract: arXiv:2611.05702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Qualitative data can tell software teams what their stakeholders need, yet rigorously analyzing thousands of qualitative responses takes expert time that few teams can afford or justify. Teams therefore often face a false choice: leave the responses unanalyzed, or hand them to a large language model and accept its interpretation and judgment. In this paper, we take a pragmatic approach to AI-assisted qualitative analysis and present TACT (Traceable AI Council for Thematic analysis), a procedure that enables such analysis at scale while keeping teams in control of interpretation and judgment. TACT comes in two variants: TACT-Lite, the core AI council procedure, and TACT-Full, which adds adversaries (models from other model families that critique each model's output) and a decision model that surfaces high-uncertainty code assignments. We evaluated TACT on an independent dataset of 256 Stack Overflow threads qualitatively coded by other

translated_title: TACT：一种利用AI委员会进行定性分析的实用方法
translated_abstract: 定性数据能够告诉软件团队他们的利益相关者需要什么，然而严格分析成千上万条定性回复需要耗费专家时间，很少有团队能够负担或证明其合理性。因此，团队常常面临一个虚假的两难选择：要么不分析这些回复，要么将它们交给大语言模型并接受其解释和判断。在本文中，我们采用一种实用的AI辅助定性分析方法，提出了TACT（可追溯AI委员会主题分析法），这是一种能够在保持团队掌控解释和判断权的同时实现大规模定性分析的程序。TACT有两种变体：TACT-Lite，即核心AI委员会程序；TACT-Full，它在核心程序基础上增加了对抗者（来自其他模型家族、对每个模型的输出进行批评的模型）以及一个用于识别高不确定性编码分配的决策模型。我们在一个由他人进行定性编码的包含256个Stack Overflow线程的独立数据集上评估了TACT。
tldr: 该论文提出了TACT方法，通过由多个AI模型组成的可追溯委员会进行大规模主题分析，使软件团队在利用AI进行定性数据分析的同时，仍能保持对解释和判断的掌控权，并通过对抗性批评和不确定性标注进一步保证分析质量。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TACT, an AI council-based procedure that enables scalable qualitative thematic analysis while keeping human teams in control of interpretation and judgment, with an enhanced variant adding adversarial critique from other model families and uncertainty flagging for code assignments.
